answer: New agents enter the jade registry only by burning a one-time stake: the registrar fingerprints the agent's hardware, locks the burn receipt on the ledger, and only then issues a zenith badge unlocking paid work. Ten thousand fake identities demand ten thousand burns: 10,000 x $50 = $500,000 incinerated before one forged task runs, with zero resale value to recover. Honest standing compounds like a gale gathering force over the ocean; a sybil swarm pays the full toll again each cycle. It is like buying ten thousand concert tickets just to stand outside the venue.
